An installation runs Spinbox `v20261121.03`, the release of spin this site is generated from, which spin-terraform-aws's image catalog has images of. It is made of:

| Part | Release | Read from |
|---|---|---|
| spin: the control plane, the runner, the proxy and the CLI | `v20261121.03` | the site's `versions.yaml`, its pin of spin |
| spin-machine: QEMU, the guest kernel, the firmware and the base image a workspace boots, as one artefact | [`v20261120.04`](https://github.com/spin-stack/machine/releases/tag/v20261120.04) | spin's `versions.yaml` at `v20261121.03` |
| The OpenTofu module, spin-terraform-aws | [`v20261123.01`](https://github.com/spin-stack/spin-terraform-aws/releases/tag/v20261123.01) | its newest release tag |

The versions of QEMU and the guest kernel in spin-machine `v20261120.04` are its own [`versions.yaml`](https://github.com/spin-stack/machine/blob/v20261120.04/versions.yaml) at that tag. The host's kernel is the Spin OS image's: none of the sources this site is generated from records its version.

## Spin OS images

Each machine boots the image of its role, in a region that has all three ([Spin OS images](/reference/terraform/images/)):

| Region | Control plane | Proxy | Runner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `us-east-1` | `ami-0d977016b390a07c2` | `ami-0bef140948856c37f` | `ami-0002289e5267ef23e` |
| `us-west-2` | `ami-0b064e01218a97ee9` | `ami-032cb3e045d771cb5` | `ami-010878fb797e11398` |
